deliverables: WP1 - Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
Use of Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and Project-Specific Smart Contract for administration and milestone-based disbursement controls
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v for administration on behalf of Wirex/vendor.
request.what: Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex, including open-source payments infrastructure, on-chain settlement, smart contracts, wallet/API ecosystem components, stablecoin-backed banking rails, and Visa card integration linked to on-chain balances.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 - Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure and 115,385 ada for an Intersect Budget Administration fee.

Wirex will deliver full-stack, open-source payments infrastructure for Cardano covering smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet and API ecosystem layers.
The proposed system is intended to enable Visa card issuance linked directly to on-chain balances so users can spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
Wirex is described as having 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, over $20 billion in transaction volume, and experience as a Visa Principal Member.

The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and references voting documentation, final audited results, and an audit report.
The requested amount is stated not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission, either alone or in aggregate.
Intersect will administer the withdrawn funds through a 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract, with stated stake and payment addresses included in the document.

Oversight is described as involving five Intersect admin roles, three Intersect leadership roles, and six external entities with multi-party authorization requirements for funding, disbursement, pause/resume, sweep, and reorganize actions.
The document states that Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.
The proposal claims the project will increase Cardano network usage, user growth, institutional participation, and real-world economic activity on-chain.

summary: The proposal is a 3,961,538 ada treasury withdrawal administered by Intersect for Wirex to build Cardano payments infrastructure, with detailed fund-routing and oversight mechanics but limited in-document evidence for the adoption and execution claims beyond external references and proposer assertions.
